description: NaH(ZnPO₄)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra, corners with five ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.72 Å. There are two inequivalent Zn sites. In the first Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 64-68°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.93-2.00 Å. In the second Zn site, Zn is bonded to four O atoms to form ZnO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with two equivalent NaO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and corners with four PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 47-73°. There are a spread of Zn-O bond distances ranging from 1.95-2.04 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one NaO₆ octahedra, corners with five ZnO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 62°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.59 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent NaO₆ octahedra and corners with three ZnO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-56°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.54-1.60 Å. H is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two O atoms. There is one shorter (1.01 Å) and one longer (1.64 Å) H-O bond length. There are eight inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Zn, one P, and one H atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one P, and one H atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Zn, and one P atom. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to two Zn and one P atom.
